Name: Victor Romance Mod SVE
Author: VeronaLuna
Description:
I originally made a save file with the main goal being romancing and eventually marrying Victor.

And I regret nothing.

After marriage, Victor is sweeter than all the Pink Cakes one could find in all of the Ferngill Republic. Similarly to Harvey, Victor turns from a nerd to an almost dorky nerd in love. However, while he is a very sweet and loving partner, the pre-marriage dialogue... doesn't really reflect that.

The whole time before getting married, Victor treats the Farmer as a friend with no hints of romantic interest whatsoever. There is a sudden change from friendship to marriage, with nothing in-between. On the other hand, all the other SVE marriage candidates have varying degrees of romantic interest towards the Farmer. Especially Olivia, should you pursue her.

Victor is base game Harvey, essentially.



This mod aims to change that.



The mod adds lines of pre-marriage, post-marriage and festival dialogue for Victor. The local rich boy also has special dialogue for when the Anniversary comes around. Stick around for a few in-game years and find out!

He now develops a crush at around 6 Hearts and it progresses the more Hearts you have with him. Additionally, he now has festival dialogue that is dependant on the number of Hearts you have with him / the relationship status. All festivals have been covered and the first changes occur at around 3-4 Hearts.
In addition to this, various NPCs in Pelican Town will comment on the relationship Victor and the Farmer have. Victor's mother and his friend group (Sam, Seb, Abigail and Sophia) now react to Farmer and Victor dating and being married. Additionally, more NPCs will react to the marriage.

And as of writing this (12.12.2023), Victor also has additional dialogue for festivals that come with the [i]Ridgeside Village[/i] mod, as well as a wedding reception photo from the custom weddings that come with RSV.


In other words, the closer you two are to each other, the more lovey-dovey this rich boy becomes. Also, there is a teeny tiny bit of suggestive language, but nothing explicit has been put into the mod.


---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------


[i]Huge kudos to FlashShifter, the creator of Stardew Valley Expanded.
Their mod is so lovely and vibrant, and honestly brings so much to the game. I'm at a point where I can no longer play the game without SVE on my mods list. Thank you for the lore, the characters, and for all your hard work. <3
[/i]

[b][u]DIALOGUE CONTENT EXAMPLES

[/u][/b]"Do your best, dearie! I know you can do it!  Here, I brought an extra coat. We can't have you freezing, now do we? I can also help you warm up later. ...What's with that face, dear?"

"It's getting quite chilly...  (Y/N), hun, would you mind if we cuddled while watching the moonlight jellies? Heh, you know that I never pass up on the opportunity to be close with you."

"I've been thinking lately... I may or may not have another reason for staying in the valley. Oh, what reason is that? Well, I... It's a secret, okay?",

"Hey there, (Y/N). Got any plans for this winter?  ...What!? (Y/N), my dear. What is this 'Skull Cavern' you're talking about? ...On the other hand, though, you have gotten me quite curious. Do tell more."
